Two Stolen Renoir Paintings Recovered in France, Six Arrested

Two paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, stolen from the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera last month, have been recovered. The theft occurred when thieves cut through a fence and smashed a window at the museum. French authorities have arrested at least five, and up to six, suspects in connection with the heist, which is estimated to be worth €9 million.
